scientific_question: When achieved coverage is experimentally assigned on a context-by-context basis, does finite-library posterior and forecast error decrease with R=M/N2 more cleanly than with raw library size?

design.task_family: x[t+1]=a*x[t]+epsilon[t], a~Uniform[-0.95,0.95], epsilon iid N(0,1), x[0]=0
design.true_assignment: For each context and target R, set M=ceil(R*N2(context)).
design.shuffled_control: Within each n, deterministically permute N2 across contexts and set M=ceil(R*N2(permuted context)). This preserves the n-specific library-budget distribution while breaking context-specific allocation.
design.pairing: Within each context and library replicate, true and shuffled assignments use nested prefixes of the same iid prior library; all target-R comparisons are therefore paired.

primary_estimand.name: posterior_mean_error_sq
primary_estimand.reason: a is bounded and this posterior functional is directly covered by self-normalized importance-sampling error theory.
primary_estimand.primary_comparison: For true assignment, mean error must decrease from target R=0.25 to R=32 for every n; the fitted log2-log2 slope over R>=2 is reported with a context bootstrap interval.
primary_estimand.positive_pattern: For all four n values, the fitted high-R slope is negative and its context-bootstrap 95% upper bound is below zero.

secondary_estimands: Posterior-mean squared error divided by continuous posterior variance
Continuous-versus-finite forecast-mean squared discrepancy at h in {1,4,16}
Forecast-mean discrepancy divided by continuous posterior predictive variance
Actual achieved log2 R after integer rounding

controls_and_reporting.shuffled_N2: Compare true and shuffled allocations at the same nominal target R using paired context-level mean errors. This is a diagnostic control, not a required theorem consequence.
controls_and_reporting.raw_M: Plot and retain raw M for every row. Do not claim that R is superior unless it improves held-out prediction or cross-n organization in the completed data.
controls_and_reporting.no_perfect_collapse_requirement: Context length and posterior geometry may retain information at matched R; perfect curve collapse is not required.
controls_and_reporting.bootstrap: Average library replicates within context first, then resample independent context clusters. Use 2000 deterministic percentile bootstrap replicates.
controls_and_reporting.rounding: Report actual achieved R=M/N2 alongside nominal target R. No row is silently dropped because ceil produces repeated M at low R.
controls_and_reporting.failed_outcome: If true allocation does not improve from the lowest to highest target for every n, or any of the four high-R slope intervals includes zero, report the result as a failure of the precommitted positive pattern.

execution.parallelization: One independent shard per n; aggregation requires all four shard metadata files and verifies source/preregistration hashes.
execution.resumability: Each n shard writes one atomic CSV and metadata JSON after completion.
